summary: Iter 62: Validated material photo upload flow + admin/toolkit mobile responsiveness (swipe-to-change-tab removed, .admin-table & .stack-table stack into cards via td[data-label] on mobile). Backend pytest 3/3 PASS (POST /api/uploads/file, PATCH material photos[] persist via GET, content-type rejection). Frontend Playwright PASS: thumbnail pm-material-photo-<id> appears after set_input_files on the hidden input inside pm-material-addphoto-<id>, persists after page reload, removable via pm-material-photo-del-<id>. At 390x844 mobile, /admin Users + Billing tabs render with 0 horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390) and .admin-table has 125 td[data-label] cells stacked as cards. PM Materials tab .stack-table also stacks with 0 overflow. Desktop 1920x1080 regression PASS: all 12 admin tabs load with 0 pageerrors, Insights panel + Analyze button render.

issues: Page rendered 0 .stack-table elements at runtime even though TaxToolkitPage.jsx source has 3 (VAT/expenses/trips tables with stack-table + min-w-[340/260/360px]). Likely just an EMPTY-DATA state for this test pro account (no expenses/trips seeded), not a code bug. No horizontal overflow either way (scrollWidth==innerWidth==390). Worth a quick smoke check by main agent with seeded tax data to confirm the stacking rule fires; not a regression vs spec.

backend_pytest_iter62: POST /api/uploads/file with text/plain -> 400 (content type filter works).

PATCH /api/pm/projects/6a283c58573a159e6192ab8d/materials/<mid> body {photos:[url]} -> 200; subsequent GET returns the material with that url inside photos[]; GET /api/uploads/<id> serves the image (200, content-type image/*).
PATCH photos:[] removes the photo; GET shows photos==[].
frontend_playwright_iter62: DESKTOP /projects/6a283c58573a159e6192ab8d -> Materials tab: hidden <input type=file> inside pm-material-addphoto-<id> label accepts set_input_files; thumbnail pm-material-photo-<id> appears within ~3.5s of upload; persists after page reload + tab re-open; removable via pm-material-photo-del-<id> after hover (also triggered confirm dialog cleanly).

MOBILE 390x844 /admin (admin@servicemarket.eu): Users tab -> scrollWidth=390 == innerWidth=390 (no overflow), 1 .admin-table with 125 td[data-label] cells (rows stack as cards). Billing tab -> same 0 overflow + 125 stacked tds.
MOBILE 390x844 /tax: 0 horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390). 0 .stack-table found at runtime (empty data state on test pro acct; not a code regression).
MOBILE 390x844 /projects/6a283c58573a159e6192ab8d Materials: 1 .stack-table with 4 td[data-label] cells, 0 horizontal overflow.

MOBILE swipe gesture: horizontal mouse drag across content area on admin Users tab did NOT navigate to a different tab (active state did not change). Synthetic TouchEvent dispatch also did not change tab. Click-on-tabstrip still works (verified by clicking admin-tab-users and admin-tab-billing).

DESKTOP 1920x1080 admin regression: 12/12 admin tabs (overview/users/jobs/projects/billing/invoicing/fees/feedback/insights/support/toolkits/paynow) clicked sequentially with 0 pageerrors during nav; data tables render rows on tabs that expose them (users:25, jobs:25, projects:5, billing:20, invoicing:1, fees:14, toolkits:1, paynow:1).
Admin Insights tab still renders panel admin-insights + admin-insights-analyze button (iter 61 feature regression OK).

critical_code_review_comments: PostHog session-recorder (posthog-recorder.js, third-party CDN) crashed with 'Cannot destructure property clientX of intermediate value' when we dispatched a synthetic TouchEvent without proper TouchList/changedTouches in the recorder's expected shape. Real mobile devices send well-formed touch events so this only surfaces under synthetic test traffic — NOT an app-side bug, but if the team wants belt-and-suspenders they could wrap PostHog init in a try/catch or disable session recording in test/preview env. Reported here just so it's not mistaken for a regression.

TaxToolkitPage.jsx still ships min-w-[340px]/[260px]/[360px] inline classes alongside stack-table. The @media (max-width:767px) display:block override neutralises min-width at runtime (confirmed: no overflow at 390px) but the redundant min-w classes are visual noise — could be removed for cleanliness.
pm_routes.py crossed 1878 lines (carried over from iter 61); still worth a refactor pass (templates/materials/payments split).

Material PATCH route accepts photos:[str] but there's no server-side validation that the URL belongs to a real /api/uploads/<id> doc OR that the uploader owns/has access to the file id. Low risk in current single-pro-per-project model, but flagging for future tightening.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (material photos + admin/toolkit mobile stacking + swipe-removed + desktop regression all green)
